realReviews.author: Oliver Smith
realReviews.text: Gary is a craftsman who loves what he does. And is very good at it. He plans his work and develops solutions with your vision in mind. He recently helped me with a new fireplace mantle. I wanted a mid-century modern look - very minimalist. Gary took my ideas and ran with them. Before long we several designs to discuss. When we had some problems with the installation, he figured it out. He’s pretty good at that. Next thing I knew, the mantle was in place. It was just what I wanted. I’m glad I got Gary to help me out.

realReviews.author: Kortney Fuller
realReviews.text: Gary did an amazing job with our built-ins in our living room! He’s very thorough and priced well! Highly recommend! Pic attached (not fully decorated yet).

realReviews.author: Zach
realReviews.text: I can’t speak highly enough of the work that Gary did for us. We were having an issue with some of our cabinets being improperly installed by another contractor. Gary came to the rescue! He truly went above and beyond just a normal repair. His work is extremely high quality. It was a real pleasure to have a kind and honest person help us. I highly recommend Gary! We are already looking for our next project!

finalCta.headline: Planning cabinets, built-ins or a mantel?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos and your ideas, or pick a time to talk it through. You'll get a clear estimate before any work starts.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight answer.

faq.q: Can you match my existing cabinets?
faq.a: Often, yes. Custom doors and panels can be made to match what you already have. Send photos for an estimate.

faq.q: Do you design the piece or do I need plans?
faq.a: Either works. Bring your idea and we'll work through designs together before anything is built.

faq.q: Do you fix cabinets someone else installed?
faq.a: Yes. Repairs and corrections to existing cabinetry are part of the work. Send details of the problem.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight through, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the project.
